title: Decrease in passenger traffic at ECP - NewsBreak
text: BAY COUNTY, Fla. (WMBB) — Airport officials report passenger traffic is lower than what they saw this time last year. The data recorded reveals traffic is 3% lower than last June. In dollar figures, when comparing the excess revenues over the expenses, it’s a total decrease of $3.7 million from June of last year. The Airport’s Executive Director Parker McClellan admits discretionary travel this year looks different across the country. McClellan says Tourism Development Council’s in the Panhandle can confirm the difference. While it is disappointing during a financial report employees said there’s no need to panic. The overall numbers are still promising. “I don’t see this as being a long-term thing that we’re down, and we’re only down 3%, but we were up 20% last year. So, I still consider that pretty good growth and we’re still up for the year by 2%. So, all those are positive numbers,” Airport Executive Director Parker McClellan said. McClellan says he’s been told airports across the panhandle are reporting similar numbers. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to mypanhandle.com.
